digest.component_or_area: capabilities - verdict signing and tier derivation
propositions: gateway/* providers with no base_url are incorrectly stamped as tier first_class instead of best_effort, misrepresenting that requests traverse an opaque intermediary
the tier derivation logic at capabilities.py:307-311 only checks base_url presence but does not account for gateway provider families that can rewrite requests
a gateway provider run carries endpoint_host=None and first_class tier, creating a signed artifact that falsely claims direct provenance from the underlying model
the fix must stamp gateway providers as best_effort via membership test rather than string prefix matching, to preserve the existing architectural guard
endpoint_host should remain None for gateway providers unless explicitly configured with a base_url, as it reports actual configuration not inferred hostnames
